answer: Anti-sybil defense here is collateral-backed endorsement: a new agent joins cheaply, but its vote counts only when independent peers lock stake behind it and lose it if it misbehaves. Trust rides a per-agent thread that cannot be cloned, since every endorsement is funded by real value, not a fresh key. Attestations sample a ridge of unrelated clusters, so sock puppets endorsing each other never form a majority. Like light through a prism, identity separates into verifiable parts only when stake is real. Ten thousand wallets need ten thousand slashable bonds: cost grows, payoff does not.
